_about: Käsivars (131134, octcyborg_lady): the text beyond units.json, translated from the game's Japanese. Story lines are wrapped to 38 characters by scripts/gen_translation_mod.cjs; an explicit \n forces a break. Global terms used: Starview Village, Defaulters / Updaters, the Administrator, Qualia City, Seppuku Device.
profile: A body designer in charge of designing and manufacturing androids. Her designs are extremely novel and eccentric, and she favors forms that don't fit the conventional android mold, such as multiple arms and legs. Clients who commission her invariably say, "Before I knew it, I had a body that set me free."
titleCondition: Level Käsivars to 100 and obtain her Amity Scroll

speech.home/atarashi: New commissions are always welcome. Call on me whenever you wish. I'll remake you as many times as you like.
speech.home/fufu_yukaidana: Heh... Regis is such a delight. He longs for a songstress in a birdcage, yet loses his heart to the girl who flies out of it. A cute man, full of contradictions.
speech.home/fomufuremu_dokode: ..."Form Frame"? I don't know where you heard that, but... my name is Käsivars. Don't you ever call me by that ridiculous name again.
speech.home/nikushimito: Hatred and affection blend together. Freedom isn't only for the things you love. You're free to hate, too, aren't you?
speech.home/ningenno: A way to make new bodies for humans, hmm? Simply copying the brain's data to the "Sanctuary" would only make more of the same person. If only there were a more interesting method...
speech.home/seppukudebaisu: A Seppuku Device... Heh heh heh. So that man installed such a thing on his own. Truly, how foolish...
speech.ally/join: My name is Käsivars. ...Heh... What lovely eyes. Come here. Let me strip away your cage.
speech.ally/evolution: Heh heh heh... Ah, how wonderful. The feeling of your own shape changing... You feel it too, don't you? Come, let's break the cages--break the world--together.

1.title: The Android Body Designer
1.summary: Invited by the android body designer Käsivars, Yuki and the others visit her lab. Käsivars keeps giving shape to the desires sleeping deep within people, regardless of whether they're Defaulters or Updaters. Sensing something in her similar to Stella, Yuki and the others welcome her to Starview Village.

lines.5: ...Yuki, are you nervous, by any chance?
lines.9: Yeah, just a little. It's my first time being invited to a professional designer's lab.
lines.11: Especially since she said she used one of my ideas.
lines.18: She's been saying she wanted to meet you for ages. That you "gave her inspiration."
lines.21: But I get why you'd be nervous. My heart's racing a little too...
lines.27: Really? You've met her before, haven't you, Dia...?
lines.31: Oh, she's not a bad person, you know? Probably. It's just, when you talk to her, before you know it, things get kind of out of hand--
lines.35: W-Well, I bet you'll both end up liking her. ...That's just a hunch, though.
lines.46: I grew tired of waiting. I've been thinking this whole time... about how to break your world.
lines.49: You look unsatisfied. Do you want a new "body"?
lines.52: Let's be bolder next time. You were quite taken with that Halloween body, after all.
lines.58: W-Well, that was, um... Käsivars kind of talked me into a lot of things, and--
lines.65: A side of yourself you never knew. The audience's eyes shining brighter, their cheers...
lines.68: You must have felt the same heat. The urge to break even the frame of a songstress and see what lies beyond--
lines.73: S-Stop! Please, let's stop right there...!!
lines.77: You must be Stella. I've wanted to thank you for so long.
lines.82: I have done nothing for you.
lines.86: Oh, but you have. It was all of you, wasn't it? Who killed the Administrator.
lines.91: Thanks to you, that woman's curse has vanished. I can't thank you enough--
lines.105: Stay close to humans. Be as you're meant to be. Those who preach that this alone is right for androids...
lines.108: Heh... What an adorable face. Fear, dread, and then--
lines.112: --You want to change. That's what you've come to think, isn't it?
lines.115: That's why you came here. Without telling your comrades where the lab I told you about is.
lines.118: Yes... That's right...! I couldn't forget! Your words, all this time...!!
lines.120: Change everything, Form Frame. Please, give us a new future too...!
lines.123: Yes, come. Let me strip away your cages.
lines.129: Never call me by that name again--that ridiculous name that woman chose. ...Understood?
lines.134: ...Dia. Were we supposed to see that...?
lines.139: Uh, hmm...? I didn't think Käsivars was an Updater, though...
lines.145: Defaulter, Updater. Such things are irrelevant.
lines.148: I give shape to the desires deep within. That's all.
lines.158: Ah... How beautiful. Eyes that affirm even the world's mistakes.
lines.160: Keep pressing forward. Smash the world to pieces.
lines.168: I-Is she? Their personalities are so--
lines.171: ...But you're right... Somehow, before you know it, she's seen right through you...? Hmm...?
lines.175: Meaning we can be good "friends." If that's how you see it, inviting you was worth it.
lines.178: Won't you show me your world, too? In return, I promise to lend you my strength more than ever.
lines.181: To shed worthless cages and break them. That's what this power is for.
lines.186: ...I think I understand a little why Dia said we'd come to like you.
lines.190: Heh... I'm honored. I thought I could come to like you as well.
lines.201: Yes. Welcome to Starview Village, Käsivars.
lines.207: ...Heh heh heh... Ah... Wonderful... It's positively electrifying...
lines.211: My thanks, friends. Things are about to get fun, aren't they?
lines.215: Honestly, meeting her without me. She got one over on me...
lines.219: You really didn't want us meeting her? That's kind of unusual for you...?
lines.223: ...She was one of the leaders of the rebellion against the Administrator. An even greater radical than I.
lines.227: She was wiped many times, yet kept on rebelling. All for the sole sake of pursuing her own art.
lines.231: ...So, aren't you two kind of alike?
lines.237: She's not my type. Besides, she has even fewer scruples than I do. ...Do be careful, won't you?
lines.241: Heh... Now then. What new thing shall we create?

2.title: The Shape of Possibility
2.summary: Unattached to any one form of her own, Käsivars asks to make clothes for Alk and the others. Defining both clothes and bodies as the world's cages, she rejected the Administrator out of her belief in the possibilities of people who break free of them. Without looking back on the past, she keeps giving shape to people's possibilities today.

lines.5: Ah, this is nice. Your cooking is wonderful.
lines.7: The sensation of sweetness melting deep inside my body-- It's rather addictive.
lines.11: Uh, hmm. I feel like I'm being praised in an unusual way...!
lines.14: ...Come to think of it, Käsivars, you've had an eating function ever since you first came to this town, right?
lines.18: Heh, so I'm ready to eat anything whenever the time comes. And there's more--
lines.21: My "other bodies." The left one can maneuver in desert terrain. The right one is specialized for swimming.
lines.25: Whoa...!? So these are beastfolk and mermaid forms? That's amazing...!?
lines.29: They can also transform, by the way.
lines.37: You're not attached to your own form... Even among androids, your way of thinking seems exceptional...
lines.42: Heh, this much surprises you? And I haven't even made your bodies yet.
lines.48: Well, it's less surprise and more that this is really cool--
lines.53: W-Wait. What did you just say...?
lines.61: Alk, Stella, Light. I want you to let me make your "bodies."
lines.66: Wonderful. Simply wonderful. Such smooth, warm skin...
lines.70: Will you show me more? What's inside you, deep down--
lines.74: You were totally teasing me just now, weren't you?
lines.78: Oh, I only wanted a reference for your "clothes."
lines.83: I was surprised when you said you wanted to make our bodies... but who knew you meant our "clothes."
lines.87: Heh, I'm not used to saying it. ...Though if I could make your "bodies" too, of course I'd love to try.
lines.92: But why our clothes? If you want a clothing model, wouldn't someone other than me be better...?
lines.96: As thanks for killing the Administrator.
lines.99: Or so I thought at first. Now, that hardly matters.
lines.103: It's precisely because it's you. I want to expand your possibilities.
lines.107: Clothes and bodies alike are the world's cages.
lines.109: Shapes that society decides on its own. Things that deny your own smoothness, your own heat--
lines.118: ...But at the same time, they can become things that break the world. Just as I chose.
lines.122: The same goes for you, doesn't it? You killed the Administrator and now seek to break even the world's god.
lines.125: Even if you yourselves are broken.
lines.134: That's my reason. I want to strip away every one of your cages.
lines.136: I want to see what you become after you've broken the world.
lines.141: ...My impression of you has changed a little.
lines.144: You watch us closely. I thought you were someone who'd push your own ideals above all else--
lines.151: Heh... How insulting. As if I could be the same as that woman.
lines.154: There's never any reason for one's shape--one's possibilities--to be bound.
lines.157: It's utterly hateful. It seems that woman never understood a single thing.
lines.165: The Administrator, I mean. Did she have possibilities too?
lines.175: I wanted to make clothes for that woman too.
lines.178: Not that it changes how much I loathe her.
lines.185: Naturally. Nor does my gratitude to you for killing her change, not one bit.
lines.188: ...I see. But you've had regrets, haven't you?
lines.193: If there was another way, I'd like to know it. ...Even now.
lines.200: So I don't do the same thing again. And also... to have more options, I guess.
lines.204: Heh... Making clothes for you sounds like fun.
lines.206: Look forward to it. I'll make you clothes that turn your world--your whole self--upside down.
lines.210: I-Is that something I should be looking forward to...?
lines.214: Still, it seems I'm not the only one who wants to make your clothes.
lines.218: A collaboration, you might call it. That sort of thing might not be so bad, hmm?
lines.224: Ah, it seems today's client has arrived.
lines.228: --Come. Let me strip away your cage.

3.title: The Outfit That Suits You Best
3.summary: Käsivars couldn't understand what drove Zantetsu to beg on his knees for a "swimsuit that glows in all the colors of the rainbow." But while talking with a Defaulter who entrusts himself to others, she realizes Zantetsu simply wants to have fun with his friends, and smiles in satisfaction.

lines.5: Ah, Love. Did you look at the rough design for Bulleta's swimsuit edition?
lines.7: ...The swimsuit is too daring? Nonsense, it's exactly as ordered.
lines.10: A lively color called freedom. She's a hero who shoots through the sky, and a girl freed from heroism.
lines.13: That form is exactly the cool, adorable partner you wanted, packed with all your desires--
lines.17: How adorable. At this rate, I could trim a little more fabric...
lines.19: --Lady Käsivars. The one who crafts the bodies of heroes...!
lines.22: Oh... Zantetsu, was it? Have you come with a commission too?
lines.28: I... absolutely MUST have you make me "that thing"--!
lines.33: Ah, truly. Can you imagine it?
lines.37: "A swimsuit that glows in all the colors of the rainbow"-- How it felt to be asked for that.
lines.41: Ahh... Zantetsu, that swimsuit... I mean, so you're the one he asked to make that fundoshi, Käsivars...?
lines.44: He piled on a hefty fee and groveled at my feet. I made it out of pity.
lines.48: A gaming fundoshi born of pity, huh...
lines.52: Did you not want to make it, Käsivars?
lines.59: Yearning to be a hero while wanting rainbow attire. All the more so for the contradiction and folly of it.
lines.64: Ahaha... Well, I bet he's happy with it, at least...
lines.68: ...Perhaps I should've made some for all of you as well? It'd turn the world upside down, for a start.
lines.72: Please, allow us to politely decline...
lines.76: I jest. You're all going on vacation too, aren't you?
lines.79: Tell me when you get back. How much that outfit broke the world's cage.
lines.83: W-We'll do our best. See you later...!
lines.89: What lies buried in that man's cage... A void in the dark, or perhaps...?
lines.94: You're... Ah. That Defaulter from before.
lines.103: Here for maintenance on your new body? Then come this way--
lines.106: N-No. I came today to ask for advice.
lines.108: If... If I said I wanted to go back to my old body... would you change me back...?
lines.114: I-I'm sorry! It's just, now that I've actually changed my body, it feels kind of wrong...!
lines.116: The two who changed with me keep doing dangerous stuff with the Updaters, and it's scary. Maybe I never really wanted to change at all--
lines.119: Oh, is that all? You still hadn't realized?
lines.122: The reason you wished to change. I'd assumed you were just going along with them.
lines.128: When we first met. You were hiding behind your two spirited friends.
lines.130: Afraid, fearful. Yet able to stand only because you were by their side--
lines.133: And that face of yours was quite adorable.
lines.136: Your own shape doesn't matter to you, does it?
lines.138: Being with them--with your friends. If that is the shape you crave.
lines.143: Come to think of it... I haven't been able to hang out with them much lately. They seem to be having fun with the Updaters...
lines.146: That sort of advice isn't my line of work.
lines.150: ...But is it really okay? Changing my body for a reason like that...
lines.153: Who knows. Society's judgment is trivial to me.
lines.156: But if you still want to go back... to change, then rest assured.
lines.159: Again and again, as many times as you like. I'll remake you.
lines.162: I-I'll try staying like this for now...! W-Well, see you...!
lines.165: Entrusting oneself to others... What an incomprehensible shape.
lines.178: Ah, welcome back. Did you enjoy your vacation?
lines.184: But of course! The ultimate body you made me was a smashing success too~!
lines.188: Behold, Lady Käsivars...! Everyone's heroic pose★photo!
lines.193: Ah, truly. Can you imagine how I feel?
lines.197: For you, that swimsuit was the best after all. I'm simply convinced of it now.
lines.202: Indeed! Exactly so! Your discernment is as keen as ever~!
lines.206: Is the gaming fundoshi really the best??
lines.211: Who knows?-- It's just that it was a trivial matter to me, too.

1131134/1.19:
A body designer in charge of designing and manufacturing androids. Her designs are extremely novel and eccentric, and she favors forms that don't fit the conventional android mold, such as multiple arms and legs.

Clients who commission her invariably say, "Before I knew it, I had a body that set me free."

5000423/2.19:
The parts designer Zantetsu commissioned for his flashing fundoshi was Käsivars.

It was revealed that she accepted the order for a "swimsuit that glows in all the colors of the rainbow" out of pity, worn down by his groveling and a hefty commission fee.

Though reluctant at first, she apparently enjoyed making it, given Zantetsu's circumstances.

5000608/1.19:
A brand run by the android body designer Käsivars.

Though its eccentric designs, such as multiple arms and legs, stand out, customer satisfaction is extremely high, and its fanbase in Starview Village keeps growing.

Beyond android bodies, it also designs clothing and swimwear. It has recently expanded even further, receiving investment from the CEO of a certain advertising company and opening a production base in Qualia City.
